settings.title: Settings
settings.app_json_must_be_array: App JSON must be an array of objects
settings.force_rebuild: Rebuild from the newest releases (no cache)
settings.marketplace_placeholder: Pick an app, or fill the fields below
settings.marketplace_helper: Apps of github.com/frappe/marketplace with a stable release for the selected Frappe version
settings.marketplace_unreachable: Cannot read the marketplace: fill the fields by hand
settings.git_token_helper: Optional. A token that can read the apps marked as private repositories. It is stored on the node and never shown again.
settings.git_token_stored: A token is stored. Type a new one to replace it.
settings.app_private: Private repository: clone it with the GitHub token

backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.managed_by_nethserver_description: Add this instance to a backup schedule in the NethServer Backup page. Every backup saves all the sites of this instance: no extra step is needed here.
backup.saved_databases: A consistent dump of the database of every site
backup.saved_files: The files of every site: site configuration, public and private files
backup.saved_settings: The instance settings: host name, apps of the image, selected apps
backup.how_to_restore_description: Restore the instance from the NethServer Backup page. The restore builds the image with the saved apps, then restores the database of every site. Let's Encrypt stays off after a restore: turn it on again in the Settings once the DNS points to the node.
backup.retention_description: Frappe keeps its own backups in each site (for example the one taken before an app is uninstalled). The module removes the old ones daily and at every NethServer backup. The newest backup of a site always stays.
backup.retention_max_age: Maximum age in days (0: no limit)
backup.retention_invalid: Enter a whole number in range

build.title: Build Docker Image
build.no_build_yet: No Docker image has been built yet

sites.title: Sites
sites.description: Each site has its own host name, Traefik route, certificate, database and apps. The default site answers on the host name of the Settings page. Apps must be part of the image: add them in the Settings page first.
sites.host_helper: The host name is also the site name. Point its DNS to this node before requesting a Let's Encrypt certificate.
sites.admin_password_helper: Password of the Administrator user of the new site. It is not stored by the module.
sites.password_too_short: The password must have at least 8 characters
sites.lets_encrypt_helper: If the certificate request fails, for example because the DNS does not point to this node yet, only this site is affected: it keeps the default certificate until the request succeeds.
sites.remove_site_description: The site {site}, its route and its database are removed. A backup of the site is kept in the sites volume, under .archived_sites.
sites.default_site_route_helper: Change the host name, HTTPS and Let's Encrypt options of the default site in the Settings page.
sites.uninstall_warning: Uninstalling {apps} deletes their data from this site. A backup of the site is taken first.
sites.running_add: Creating the site and installing its apps: this takes a few minutes.
sites.running_apps: Installing and uninstalling apps: this takes a few minutes.
sites.running_route: Updating the route of the site.
sites.site_already_exists: A site with this host name already exists
sites.domain_already_used_in_traefik: Host name already used by another route
sites.app_not_in_image: This app is not part of the image
sites.module_not_running: Configure and start the instance first
sites.scheduler_inactive: Enabled, but no scheduled job ran recently
sites.queue_error: The job queues cannot be read
sites.archived_description: A removed site is kept in the sites volume, with the backup taken at removal, until you delete it. Restoring it brings back its files and database, with a route without Let's Encrypt.
sites.archived_delete_description: The files and the backup of the removed site {site} are deleted permanently.
sites.running_restore: Restoring the removed site: this takes a few minutes.
sites.archived_site_not_found: The removed site does not exist
